items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: APSB26-92 addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw allowing customer account takeover. It also fixes stored XSS issues leading to arbitrary code execution and security feature bypasses.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: APSB25-71 addresses critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Specific CVEs include CVE-2025-49554, CVE-2025-49555, CVE-2025-49556, CVE-2025-49557.

items.title: CosmicSting Attack leading to persistent backdoors and RCE
items.summary: CosmicSting (CVE-2024-34102) is a critical vulnerability actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts into CMS blocks and establish persistent backdoors, potentially leading to remote code execution. Sansec observed mass abuse starting in July 2026.

items.title: Critical Unauthenticated Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: APSB26-73 includes CVE-2026-48358, a critical unauthenticated, zero-interaction arbitrary code execution vulnerability in the webhooks component with a CVSS score of 10.0. It also addresses other high-severity issues like planting malicious files and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: CVE-2026-53787 is an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension, allowing attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without authentication, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: CVE-2026-45247 is a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, exploitable via a crafted cookie to achieve remote code execution. Mirasvit released version 1.11.12 to fix this flaw.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: PolyShell (CVE-2025-20720) is a critical flaw in Magento's REST API allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable polyglot files, leading to remote code execution or account takeover. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 with a fix on May 12, 2026, but older versions may remain vulnerable without isolated patches.
